key.name: command-shortcut
key.description: Hold it and say what to do; tap it for hands-free listening.

key.name: mode
key.description: auto: hold the modifier or tap. hold: release always stops. toggle: the shortcut starts and stops.

key.name: tap-ms
key.description: Releasing the modifier within this many milliseconds counts as a tap.

key.name: silence-stop-s
key.description: In hands-free mode, stop listening after this many seconds of silence. 0 = never.

key.name: llm
key.description: Send requests the rules do not understand (shell commands, questions) to Ollama on this computer.

key.name: llm-model
key.description: Model name as listed by `ollama list`.

key.name: llm-url
key.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.

key.name: work-dir
key.description: Where confirmed commands run. Empty = the home folder.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon and menu in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: show-hud
key.description: Show the microphone level, the words heard and the result.

key.name: hud-position
key.description: island: a capsule that swells out of the top bar, centred, like a phone's Dynamic Island. cursor: next to the text cursor or the pointer.

key.name: microphone
key.description: PipeWire node name of the microphone to record from. Empty = the system default input.
